property_info: Self check-in from 15:00, check-out by 11:00. Wi-Fi network: Bryggen-Loft (the password is on the fridge). Bins are in the courtyard: paper in the blue one. Bryggen and the fish market are a 5-minute walk; the Floibanen funicular is 10 minutes away. Towels and bed linen are in the hallway cupboard.
